title: UpdateStatus
description:
How the installed build compares with the newest published release.

`latest` is absent when the repository has no published release yet, which is a normal
answer rather than a failed check. The comparison itself is the screen's: a build older
than the tag is a newer release, and the tag is what the release page is named after.

checked_at.description: When this answer was produced, so the screen can say how old it is.

current.description: Version of this build, from the package manifest.

latest.description: Newest published tag without its leading `v`, or absent when none is published.

published_at.description: When the release was published, as the forge reports it.

url.description: The release page the result links to.
